notes: Accordion SoundTrail coverage now spans 32 researched styles and traditions.
Every Accordion style has at least three verified Spotify track examples; playlists, albums, and artist pages do not count toward the example minimum.
Added Chamamé, Merengue Típico, Swiss Schwyzerörgeli, Brazilian Gaúcho / Vanerão, and Colombian Cumbia / Tropical Accordion.
Added third-track coverage to previously thinner styles including Cajun, Basque Trikitixa, Finnish Folk, Klezmer, Norteño, Zydeco, Russian Bayan, and others.
SoundTrail's general rule remains at least two verified track examples per style, with three preferred when the research supports it; Accordion now enforces three.
